description: This SQL script initializes a sports telecast database by inserting sample emoji data, creating reaction summary views, and defining functions for managing emoji reactions and retrieving reaction statistics.
calls: SELECT emoji_id INTO v_emoji_id FROM emoji_assets WHERE emoji_type = p_emoji_type AND is_active = true LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO emoji_reactions (user_id, event_id, match_id, emoji_id) VALUES (p_user_id, p_event_id, p_match_id, v_emoji_id)
